privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy notice.
privacy.lead: How we handle the information you share with us.
privacy.seoDesc: How Silk Road Capital handles the information shared through this website.
privacy.s1.title: What we collect
privacy.s1.text: When you submit the enquiry form we receive the details you choose to provide: your name, company, email address, country, areas of interest and your message. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies on this website.
privacy.s2.title: How we use it
privacy.s2.text: We use your details only to respond to your enquiry and, where you agree, to continue the conversation about a potential engagement. We do not sell or rent personal data, and we do not add you to marketing lists without consent.
privacy.s3.title: Confidentiality
privacy.s3.text: Enquiries are read only by the Silk Road Capital team. Information about opportunities and businesses is never shared with third parties without your consent, and detailed information is exchanged under NDA where appropriate.
privacy.s4.title: Retention
privacy.s4.text: We keep enquiries only as long as needed to respond and to manage any resulting relationship, and delete them on request where we are not required to retain them.
privacy.s5.title: Your rights
privacy.s5.text: You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you by replying to our correspondence or through the enquiry form.
